label: prf:adelic-reeb-restricted-product
title: Proof of adelic reeb restricted product
html:
Proof. Proof of adelic reeb restricted product

Proof. Both parts are proved formally over the abstract value group \Gamma in adelic-reeb-restricted-product.lean. The restricted-product condition is encoded by an explicit finite set S of active places (those with \ordw_v \neq 0); off S the local order is the tame archimedean reference 0, so the sum is finite and well-defined. Additivity (adelic_reeb_order_additive) is pointwise addition of local orders summed over S (\sum_S (a+b) = \sum_S a + \sum_S b). The squeeze (adelic_reeb_squeeze_local_to_global) is Finset.sum_lt_sum: a finite sum of weak inequalities with one strict term is strict. \square

Tate's thesis. This is the surreal-register form of Tate's adelic factorisation [tate1967]: where Tate writes the global zeta integral as a restricted product of local zeta integrals \zeta_v(f_v, s) — one per place — the substrate writes the global Reeb infinitesimal \varepsilon as the restricted product of local \varepsilon_v, and the global valuation as the sum of local valuations. Part 1 is the valuation-theoretic shadow of the Euler product; part 2 promotes the single global \varepsilon-squeeze of surreal squeeze to a separate squeeze at each prime, which is the local–global content used by adelic–Tate surreal squeeze.

Extra structure — consistency across places. The hypothesis that all local orders \ordw_v land in one common value group \Gamma is not free: it is the requirement that the per-place surreal orders be commensurable — a single coherent birthday filtration spanning every prime and the archimedean place v = \infty simultaneously. Without it the sum \sum_v \ordw_v(f_v) does not even typecheck. This shared \Gamma is the genuine additional structure the adelic lift exposes (formalised in Lean as a linearly ordered abelian group: AddCommGroup + LinearOrder + IsOrderedCancelAddMonoid): it is what makes the two dual archimedean reductions of adelic–Tate surreal squeeze — the fibre functor \tau_{\mathrm{arch}} = \pi_\infty across places, and the standard part \mathrm{St} : \mathbf{No} \to \mathbb{R} along the filtration — land in the same ordered target, and it is the natural place to look for further exploitable rigidity (e.g. the automorphic generalisation flagged in the outlook of adelic–Tate surreal squeeze).

Downstream. This proposition supplies the local–global skeleton consumed by adelic–Tate surreal squeeze and, through it, the leading-coefficient reduction of BSD surreal bound. The squeeze content is purely structural: it takes the per-place inequalities as hypotheses and is therefore independent of the q-NS conjecture cone behind surreal squeeze.
